scope: Proposition 11.5 (Saturated centers and actual colored witnesses) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 128. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Equation (11.4). There is a subsequence and deterministic Hj, kj, Lj → ∞ such that Lj = o(Tj) and Lj = o(log Hj) with the following properties. Choose a finite set of centers Cj at the seed level Yj, then independently choose Uj ∼ Unif[0, Lj] and put Xj = Yj − Uj. The centers have a finite limiting count K with EK ≤ C, remain mutually divergent in rj(Xj) units, and have tight access depths. At both Vj = Yj and Vj = Xj, for every fixed k, lim A→∞ lim sup j→∞ Qj " sup t∈Rj,k(Vj) dist(t, Cj) rj(Vj) > A # = 0. (11.5) Finite access witnesses and finitely many actual colored edges can be chosen simultaneously so that their access depths are tight and all their within-line time offsets collapse after coarsening. The limiting colored graph contains every edge which is witnessed by an actual link at bounded reach and bounded line coordinates at the coarsened level.
